$broadcast_topic_desc.en: Default broadcast topic template. Use ${productKey} as placeholder.
$broadcast_topic_desc.zh: 默认广播 Topic 模板，使用 ${productKey} 作为占位符。

$batch_topic_desc.en: Default batch publish topic template. Use ${productKey} and ${deviceName} as placeholders.
$batch_topic_desc.zh: 默认批量下发 Topic 模板，使用 ${productKey} 和 ${deviceName} 作为占位符。

$msg_ttl_desc.en: Message time-to-live. Messages older than this will be deleted.
$msg_ttl_desc.zh: 消息存活时间，超过此时间的消息将被清理。

$cleanup_interval_desc.en: Interval for scanning and cleaning expired messages.
$cleanup_interval_desc.zh: 扫描并清理过期消息的时间间隔。

$max_device_count_desc.en: Maximum number of devices per BatchPub request.
$max_device_count_desc.zh: 单次 BatchPub 请求的最大设备数。

$max_message_size_broadcast_desc.zh: PubBroadcast 单条消息的最大字节数。

$max_message_size_batch_desc.en: Maximum message size (bytes) for BatchPub. Binary size, not Base64 encoded.
$max_message_size_batch_desc.zh: BatchPub 单条消息的最大字节数（纯二进制大小，非 Base64 编码后的大小）。

$msg_warn_threshold_desc.en: Warning threshold for pending message count.
$msg_warn_threshold_desc.zh: 待处理消息数的告警阈值。

$force_upgrade_qos_desc.en: When true, QoS 1 messages are always published at QoS 1 regardless of the device subscription QoS. When false, the effective QoS is min(publish QoS, subscription QoS) and downgraded QoS 0 deliveries are completed immediately.
$force_upgrade_qos_desc.zh: 为 true 时,QoS 1 消息始终以 QoS 1 下发,忽略设备订阅 QoS;为 false 时,实际 QoS 取 min(发布 QoS, 订阅 QoS),降级为 QoS 0 的投递立即完成。

$delivery_pool_size_desc.en: Number of async delivery workers. 0 means one worker per scheduler.
$delivery_pool_size_desc.zh: 异步投递 worker 数量。0 表示每个调度器一个 worker。

$delivery_queue_max_desc.en: Maximum number of queued delivery tasks. When exceeded, new BatchPub requests are rejected with 429.
$delivery_queue_max_desc.zh: 排队投递任务的最大数量。超过后新的 BatchPub 请求将被拒绝并返回 429。
